title: Senior Automation Engineer
description:
Main Event Entertainment is seeking a Senior Automation Engineer who is passionate about building innovative solutions. This is an exciting opportunity to make a real impact in a fast-growing organization.

As a Senior Automation Engineer, you will play a key role in shaping the future of our tech capabilities. You will work closely with our product, engineering, and business teams to deliver high-quality solutions.

- Develop and implement strategies that align with company goals
- Analyze data and metrics to measure impact and drive improvements
- Stay up-to-date with industry trends and best practices
- Build and maintain strong relationships with internal and external partners

- 9+ years of relevant experience
- Expertise in Docker, GraphQL, JavaScript, TypeScript

- Strong analytical and strategic thinking skills
- Excellent written and verbal communication abilities

**Compensation & Benefits:**
- Annual salary: A$150,000 – A$200,000
- Hybrid work options available

- Premium health insurance
- 401k/pension with company match
- Flexible working hours
